scripts.build:setup:frontend: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.setup.config.ts
scripts.build:updater:frontend: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.updater.config.ts
scripts.build:setup: npm run build:setup:frontend && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --locked --features installer-native,custom-protocol --bin FluxoraSetup
scripts.build:updater: npm run build:updater:frontend && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --locked --features installer-native,custom-protocol --bin FluxoraUpdater
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run stage:native && tauri build --no-bundle -- --locked
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:ai-gate: vitest run tests/ai-single-agent-contract.test.ts tests/ai-single-agent-state.test.ts tests/ai-single-agent-panel.test.tsx tests/ai-gateway-v2.test.ts tests/ai-voice-contract.test.ts tests/ai-voice-state.test.ts tests/ai-voice-transcription.test.ts tests/ai-voice-processing-indicator.test.tsx
scripts.test:installer-ui: vitest run tests/setup-flow.test.ts tests/setup-component.test.tsx tests/updater-flow.test.ts tests/installer-facade-contract.test.ts tests/legal-documents-panel.test.tsx tests/icon-provenance.test.ts
scripts.test:installer-e2e: npm run build:setup:frontend && npm run build:updater:frontend && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test e2e/installer-targets.spec.ts
scripts.parity:gate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:setup:frontend && npm run build:updater:frontend && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --pass-with-no-tests
